snapshot.title: END: Pressure District 7 Shutdown Complete

fields.resolution: ENDEX. It is now 19:30. The shutdown of Pressure District 7 has been completed. RCV-01 and RCV-04 are confirmed closed. Valve 11 and Valve 12 are closed on site. Field gauges at RS-21 and RS-22 now read 0 in. w.c. PR-7B is offline but pressure is stable. No further incidents have been reported. The EOC remains activated. Forensic teams have begun collecting evidence from CVG-OT-JMP01 and the RTUs. CISA has been notified and is reviewing the memory image. The IC has authorized the start of the phased return to control under C8. The hot wash will now begin.
finalState: Pressure District 7 is fully isolated via RCV-01, RCV-04, Valve 11, and Valve 12.
Field gauges at RS-21 and RS-22 read 0 in. w.c. and are stable.
PR-7B is offline but pressure is not rising.
CVG-OT-JMP01 memory image (ID: 0x9A2F) has been collected and tagged.
CISA has received the forensic package and is conducting review under SD Pipeline-2021-02G.
fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Put down your phones and radios. We will take ten minutes, then start the hot wash.
fields.hotWashMethod: 3-Up, 3-Down: three things that went well, three things that broke
hotWashQuestions: How did the team reconcile the discrepancy between SCADA and field data, and what safeguards could prevent this in the future?
What were the key decision points in authorizing manual isolation, and how could communication be improved under time pressure?
How effective was the coordination between field, control, and external agencies during the incident?
What lessons can be drawn from the fake social media post and public trust challenges?
How did the forensic process align with C4 and C9 requirements, and what would you change in a real incident?
fields.facilitatorNote: Collect all ICS 201 forms, evaluator sheets, and evidence logs before the hot wash. Ensure CISA’s review status is noted in the master tracker.
